concepts.prompt: Game asset concept: a monumental carved stone portal gate for the end wall of a great hall, tall arched doorway 4.5 m tall, 3.6 m wide, 0.6 m deep. Pale warm limestone (#d2c6af) blocks with chunky bevelled voussoirs and a keystone, thick square pillars with plinths, the same proportions and silhouette as the arch reference. Deep carved rune channels inlaid with glowing tether-blue (#4aa8e0) light run up both pillars and around the arch like the glowing spiral rune on the standing stone in the key art, with a tether-knot rune on the keystone. Bronze-brown metal brackets sparingly. The opening is open/empty (no door). Stylised Palworld-like game prop, chunky readable shapes, soft bevelled edges, hand-painted PBR look, warm natural palette matching the Meadows key art (first reference). Single isolated object, centred, neutral grey background, even studio lighting, no text, no characters, no ground clutter.

agent_visual_verdict: Strong: tall pale-stone arch, glowing tether-blue rune channels, matches portal silhouette; emissive mask derived for rune material.
notes: Meshy outputs one PBR material; *_emissive_mask.png isolates the blue rune texels (derived by colour threshold from base colour) for a separate emissive material at integration.
